item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meera watches the Sun set from her balcony in Jaipur in the evening, while her cousin in school learned that it is already night in some other parts of the world. What causes day and night on Earth?

options.A: Earth orbiting the Sun once every year
options.B: Earth rotating on its axis, turning each place towards and away from the Sun
options.C: the Moon blocking the Sun's light every evening
options.D: the Sun moving around Earth once a day
